_comment: prism_reservoir/02_single_triangle_y10 (2026-09-09): the 01 design scaled down in y — reservoir 6 x 10 um, prism long side 10 um on the left wall, floor edge 2 um, same 11.31-deg angle, theta=0 anchoring, n||z bulk. Optics identical: 550-nm gaussian beam (w0 6) from the 1-um air guide, 0.5-um air guide behind with centred n2f line + DFTs.

polygons._comment: the prism, y=10 variant: vertical long edge 10 um on the LEFT wall (full height), floor edge 10*0.2=2 um, hypotenuse (2,0)->(0,10). Same angle tan(phi)=0.2 (11.31 deg from vertical). Anchoring theta=0 (n||z) on all edges.

lc_1._comment: LC config v2 (user): director ALONG Z everywhere — code-theta seed 0 (n = z-hat), both phi and theta free in the relax. Expectation: uniform n||z is a zero-torque equilibrium (elastically uniform; the prism's tangent phi-anchoring is moot at theta=0 since the in-plane component vanishes), so the relaxation should NOT move it — this run verifies that. Note optically (2D TE, Ey): n||z presents the ordinary index n_o=1.531 everywhere, nearly matching the prism's n=1.5.

source_1._comment: wide gaussian beam across the full cell height, 550 nm, from the 1-um air guide

n2f_map._comment: far field from the n2f line at the CENTER of guide_2 (moved off the guide/PML edge)
